protocol.zero_leakage_holdout: Pre-registered canonical 25-case evaluation set from RE1-TT: all 5 target services x all 5 fault types (cpu, mem, disk, delay, loss), repetition 2, zero tuning against production defaults. Schema verified on rep-1 single case only.
protocol.symmetric_comparators: Identical strictly causal imputation (ffill then 0.0, never bfill) and max-over-metrics service aggregation across all methods. causalsieve_tier2 and causalsieve_tier1_blind receive ZERO inject_time knowledge; causalsieve_tier1, raw_max_z, rolling_mad_z, pairwise_granger_z, and sklearn_isolation_forest share the symmetric baseline[:inject_index] / incident[inject_index:] split. pairwise_granger_z uses baselines.py's built-in top-48 robust-MAD pre-screen when active channels > 48 (2,256 pairs/case).
